Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

wcvpmatch 0.0.3

  • Load only candidate genera from a versioned wcvpdata Arrow dataset when prefilter_genus = TRUE, then fetch accepted-name metadata by identifier. Retain the full-table path for custom or older backbones and explicit prefilter_genus = FALSE.

  • Resolve taxonomic context once per taxon key and normalized submitted name, preserving authorship-sensitive selection when expanding duplicate inputs.

  • Bound species and infraspecies fuzzy distance batches to 50,000 pairs, prune impossible lengths before distance calculation, and retain all nearest ties.

  • Lazily reuse exact keys, accepted-ID indexes, species and infraspecies tables, and suffix roots. Column edits or subsets invalidate cached indexes; only the most recent prefiltered default target is retained across calls.

  • Normalize pipeline input once and generate missing input names with vector operations. Standalone matching nodes retain input normalization.

  • Skip full-backbone component normalization when the installed wcvpdata accessor declares matching schema version 1 with the required character columns. Preserve normalization for older or unknown schemas and custom backbones, including edited tables carrying provider attributes.

  • Restores WCVP identifiers, authorship, taxonomic status, and accepted-name context for valid matched names.

  • Resolves tied fuzzy genus candidates with exact species evidence when unique, and reports the decision in the new match_ambiguity output column.

wcvpmatch 0.0.2

CRAN release: 2026-09-09

wcvpmatch 0.0.1

CRAN release: 2026-03-23

  • Initial release to CRAN.
  • Standardizes and reconciles scientific plant names against the World Checklist of Vascular Plants (WCVP).
  • Implements staged exact and fuzzy matching at genus, species, and infraspecies levels.
  • Supports robust scientific name parsing through classify_spnames().
  • Provides traceable results with original and matched components.
